translation.name: Kameethari Ñaantsi: ikenkitha-takoitziri awinkatharite Jesucristo; Owakerari aapatziya-wakagaantsi

content: Iro oshiyakawori aamparentsi jiroka Inintakaantaitanewo. Okantaganki aamparentsi te otzimanetzi owatha, apatziro riyotaitziro eenitatsi iita ashitawori raampare. Ari okantari eejatzi Inintakaantaitanewo, riyoitzi tzimatsi paata kameethataatsine. Inintakaantaitake ritagaitapiinteniri Pawa maawoini osarentsiki, iro kantacha te owameethashireperoteri atziripaini antayetakerori.
Imaperotatyeeyaame owameethashireperotante, ikaatzi antayetakerori ari ripakaakerome, tema oiteshiretakeri, eero okatsitzimoshirewaitzirime rantayetakerowa kaariperori.
Te ari onkantya, tema rantapiintashitakawo awisayetzira osarentsipaini, ritagaitapiintzinirira Pawa, ikenkithashiretakotawowa iyaariperoshirenka.
Tema rowamagaitapiintziri piratsi ikapathainkatakagaitziri, te imatzimaityaawo ompeyakoperotero iyaariperonka atziri.
Irooma ripokakera pairani Cristo jaka kipatsiki, ikantakeri Pawa:

content.text: Iroowa pikowaperotake potyaantena naaka natziritzimotante, noshiyakotyaari ratsipetakagaitanewo.
Te apa inimotemi ritagaitzimiri piratsi okantakaantziro iyaariperoshirenka jirikapaini.
Pawá, nipokake naaka nantairo okaatzi pikowakaakenari eeroka,

content: Pinkenkithashiretero kantatsiri jaka:

content.text: Te pikowajaantairi ramayeetemiri piratsi rashitakagaitemiri, ritagaitemiri.

content: Iro kantacha, ¿kaarima Inintakaantaitanewo okaatzi añaakeri?
Pinkenkithashireterotya otsipa kantatsiri:

content.text: Nipokake naaka nantairo okaatzi pikowakaakenari eeroka,

content: Jiroka apiitainchari ikantaitakeri, poyaataawori etanakawori pairani.
Ikowake Pawa oshiyaawo iwatha Cristo okaatzi ritagaitziniriri, opoñaantari ikamawentapaintziri maawoini atziripaini. Arira opoñagaari rowameethashireyetai aakapaini.
Pairani, maawoini Imperatasorentsitaarewo raminiri Pawa rashitakaariri, rapiipiintziro kiteesheriki ritayiniri piratsi. Temaita rimatziro ripakaaperotakaantero kaariperori.
Iriima Cristo, apawosatzi rishinetaka rowamaawentaiteri iyaariperonka atziripaini, saikai rakoperoki Pawa itsipataari ipinkathariwentantzi,
ari risaiki royaawenta irojatzi roitsinampaaperotantaiyaariri iisaneentane, roshiyakagairi rimakoryaayitzimento.
Irootake rantantakawori apawosatzi ikamawentakero iyaariperonka atziripaini, tema ari rashi rowatyeero rowameethashireperoyetai.
Ari ikantakari Tasorenkantsi riyotakaakai imaperotatya. Tema iri etakawori rosankenatakaantake:
Eekero ikantatzi:
Tema ipeyakotakaantairo Pawa ikaariperoshiretaitzira, te okameethatzi ritagaitainiri iroñaaka.
Iyekiite, tema kapathainka ikantaka Jesucristo rowamaantaitakariri, awentaashire antsipashiretaiyaari Pawa, oshiyawaityaawo ankyagaatyeeme tasorentsinakiperoriki.

Tema ratziritake Cristo, irootake okantantaari ankyaayetai inkiteki, iro oshiyarime ankyagaatyeeme ithataitakerowa tontamawotatsiri tasorentsinakiperoriki. Aaka omapokayetairori jiroka kaari rimataitzi pairani, iroowa kañaanetakaantaatsiri.
Roshiyakari iroñaaka Cristo iriime Imperatasorentsiperowentaine akaatzira rashiyetai Pawa.

Ari okanta. Kyaaryooperoini ankantaiya antsipashiretaiyaari Pawa, imaperowa oshiretaiyaari. Kiteshirera ikantakaayetai, eero akenkithashiretakotaawo kaariperori. Oshiyawaitaawo inkiwantaatyeerome ñaa kityaanikiri.
Kiso owanakeri awentaashiretaari, ikemayeetakai akantake: “Noyaakoneentanewo rinatzi Cristo.” Tema tsika itzimi kashaakagairori, kisokero rowakai irirori.
Ontzimatye ankenkithashiretakotairo tsika onkantya ominthashiretakaantyaariri itsipa retakotane, rantayetairo kameethari.
Eero apakairo apatotapiintaiya, tema tzimayetatsi pakaayetakerori. Ontzimatye ominthashiretakagaiyaari akaataiyinira. Eekero aatatye antanairo ayotaira aritake ripiyai Cristo.
Ikamantaitziriri antzirori inintakaanekiini kaariperori
Ayowetaawowa irooperotatsiri, arika othatagairo antapiintanairo kaariperori, tera ipeyakoitairo ayaariperonka.
Ikamantaitakai anthaawashirete rowasanketaitai, tema Pawa rithonkaatyeeri ritaayetairi ikaatzi kisaneentakeriri.

Pairani, iitarika piyathatakyaawone Inintakaantaitane rosankenatakeri Moisés, te ineshironkaitziri rowamagaitziri inkaaterika mawa thawetakoterine. Ari rowamagaitakeri eejatzi intzimaatsikaiterika apite thawetakoterine.

¿Tema imaperotatya rowasanketaiteri maninterone rantzimotakairi Itomi Pawa? Tema roshiyakagaitakero raatzikashiwaitaitawo kaari pantyaawone, imanintashiwaitakyaawome ikapathainkatake ikamawentantake. Ari rithainkashiretakero raapatziyantzi Pawa ikashaakaawetakari intasorentsishiretakairi. Ikaweyawaitakeri Tasorenkantsi neshironkatantaneri.
Irooma aakapaini ayotziri kantaintsiri:
Ikantaitzi eejatzi:
¡Antawoitewé inthaawashiretaite riyotaite iriitakera owasanketantaatsine Pawa Kañaaneri!
Pinkenkithashiretakotya. Tema eerokatake kemisantanaintsiri pairani, oshiyawaitakawo pinkiteesheenkatakotaatyeeme. Irojatzi piñaantakawori ikemaatsitakagaitakemi.
Piñaayetakero eejatzi ikisaitzimi, rowatsinagaitzimi tsika rapatoita. Poimoshirenkayetakeri awishimotziri okaatzi piñaakeri eeroka.

Poimoshirenkayetakeri ikaatzi romonkyagaitakeri, piñaayetakero eejatzi raapithaitakemiro oshekitzimotzimiri. Iro kantacha, eekero piyaatatzi pominthashiretanaka, tema piyotaiyironi onkaate piñagairi paata, osheki okameethaperotzi, eero ithonkaawo.
Irootake eero pipakaantawo okaatzi pawentaanaari, tema antawoite ripinaitaimi paata.
Kisashire pinkantya pantayetanairo ikowakaimiri Pawa, piñaantaiyaawori ikashaakaakemiri.

content.text: Tampatzikashire rinatye awentaashireri, ari iñagairo rañaantaiyaawo.

content: Irooma aakapaini, te oshiyari piyashiretachari, rithonkaitairi. Oshireyetaaga aakapaini, ari añagairo añaashireyetai.
